messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.
